title: High-Content Image-Based Screening and Deep Learning for the Detection of Anti-Inflammatory Drug Leads.
authors: Lau, Tannia A; Mair, Elmar; Rabbitts, Beverley M; Lohith, Akshar; Lokey, R Scott
journal: Chembiochem : a European journal of chemical biology
one_liner_zh: 该文利用高内涵成像和深度学习筛选抗炎药物，完全不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: We developed a high-content image-based screen that utilizes the pro-inflammatory stimulus lipopolysaccharide (LPS) and murine macrophages (RAW264.7) with the goal of enabling the identification of novel anti-inflammatory lead compounds. We screened 2,259 bioactive compounds with annotated mechanisms of action (MOA) to identify compounds that block the LPS-induced phenotype in macrophages. We utilized a set of seven fluorescence microscopy probes to generate images that were used to train and optimize a deep neural network classifier to distinguish between unstimulated and LPS-stimulated macrophages. The top hits from the deep learning classifier were validated using a linear classifier trained on individual cells and subsequently investigated in a multiplexed cytokine secretion assay. All 12 hits significantly modulated the expression of at least one cytokine upon LPS stimulation. Seven of these were allosteric inhibitors of the mitogen-activated protein kinase kinase (MEK1/2) and showed similar effects on cytokine expression. This deep learning morphological assay identified compounds that modulate the innate immune response to LPS and may aid in identifying new anti-inflammatory drug leads.
abstract_zh: 我们开发了一种基于高内涵成像的筛选方法，利用促炎刺激物脂多糖（LPS）和鼠巨噬细胞（RAW264.7），旨在识别新型抗炎先导化合物。我们筛选了2,259种具有注释作用机制（MOA）的生物活性化合物，以识别阻断LPS诱导的巨噬细胞表型的化合物。我们使用一组七种荧光显微镜探针生成图像，用于训练和优化深度神经网络分类器，以区分未刺激和LPS刺激的巨噬细胞。深度学习分类器中的顶级命中通过基于单个细胞训练的线性分类器进行验证，随后在多重细胞因子分泌测定中进一步研究。所有12个命中在LPS刺激下均显著调节至少一种细胞因子的表达。其中七种是丝裂原活化蛋白激酶激酶（MEK1/2）的变构抑制剂，并对细胞因子表达显示出相似效应。这种深度学习形态学测定识别出调节对LPS的先天免疫反应的化合物，可能有助于发现新的抗炎药物先导物。
